body:
Be advised, the server is still in 1.21.? because of plugin updates.

⚔️ AXEL MC ⚔️

Axel MC is a Minecraft survival server built for players who love adventure, creativity, and community. Here, every player gets the chance to create their own journey — from building powerful bases to exploring new lands and facing exciting challenges. Whether you enjoy survival, teamwork, competition, or making unforgettable memories with friends, Dagger MC gives you a place to experience it all. Join a growing community, write your own story, and become part of the Dagger MC legacy. Every adventure begins with a single step — your journey starts here.
